scale_cues: I used the large white square dinner plate, about 27 cm across, and the edge of the tray under it. The fork tines at the top left also helped. The food takes up roughly the upper half of the plate.
assumptions: I only counted the food on the center plate. The plate partly visible on the left has olives, cherry tomatoes and shredded carrot, and I left it out because it looks like a separate dish.
The meat looks like sliced beef steak. It could also be liver or another dark meat, so I'm less sure about it.
The dark slices at the left edge, under the rice, look like mushroom. They could also be pieces of meat.
I assumed oil was used because the vegetables look sautéed or roasted and have a shiny surface.
The tomato bits and seasoning crumbs on the meat are counted with the meat because they weigh less than 5 g.
